description: Defines deep link routing and parsing for the OpenClawKit app, including URL schemes for agent and gateway connections, with associated data structures and parsing logic.

classes.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink
classes.description: Represents connection details for a gateway, including URL parsing and base64 decoding.

classes.name: AgentDeepLink
classes.description: Represents an agent message deep link with session and delivery options.

methods.name: fromSetupCode
methods.description: Parses a base64url-encoded JSON setup code into a GatewayConnectDeepLink object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into Data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL into a DeepLinkRoute (agent or gateway) based on custom URL scheme.
